patterns: Direct monument -> builder questions dominate (Red Fort, Jama Masjid Delhi, Bibi ka Maqbara, Itimad-ud-Daula, Moti Masjid Red Fort).
APPSC uses 'built in Akbar's reign' statement sets (Salim Chishti tomb, Buland Darwaza, Humayun's tomb, Jami Masjid - all four) and 'not built by Shah Jahan' odd-one-out.
Monument -> place match lists with Char Minar (Hyderabad) as the AP-flavoured distractor; Akbar's tomb = Sikandara.
Recurring traps: Buland Darwaza = Gujarat victory (not Jahangir's birth), Panch Mahal = Buddhist vihara design, Ibadat Khana = interfaith debates hall.
App adds historiography (V.A. Smith), UNESCO years and Bahmani/Qutb Shahi comparisons - deeper than the PYQs but mostly sound; a few off-topic Chola/Peshwa capital items sit here.
